Part I:  A Guide to Healthy Nutrition
Others, like the well-known multivitamins, may contain an
entire panel of vitamins and minerals in amounts close to
the Dietary Reference Intakes (DRIs).  Still other supple-
ments may not contain any substances yet identified as
nutrients or even demonstrated as beneficial to health.  
With few exceptions, foods are better sources than sup-
plements for the nutrients we need.  A diet based on the
